subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository accept this grouped set of new third-party Action revisions across secret-bearing, security-scanning, publishing, and Codex workflows?
rationale: Automated diff review can confirm immutable pins and unchanged workflow inputs, but it cannot authorize new executable supply-chain revisions that receive credentials or security-sensitive permissions, especially while the repository's direct Codex-source gate remains incomplete.

options.title: Approve After Owner Audit
options.body: Security and CI/release owners review the exact upstream SHAs and land the grouped update after all exact-head workflows complete successfully.

options.title: Split Privileged Updates
options.body: Separate Codex, token-creation, CodeQL, and Docker-publishing revisions into narrower PRs when independent audit or rollback is preferred.

options.title: Pause This Bundle
options.body: Leave or close the grouped update until each sensitive Action revision has a clear owner and validation path.

recommendation.title: Approve After Owner Audit
recommendation.body: Security and CI/release owners review the exact upstream SHAs and land the grouped update after all exact-head workflows complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns central security-scanning and dependency-guard workflow surfaces to this review group.
